name: @drymdf/desktop
description: Offline Markdown editor and PDF exporter for macOS
author: Ajay Mandal

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @drymdf/frontend exec tsc ../backend/src/modules/pdf/print-layout.ts --outDir ../desktop/build --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module commonjs && DRYMDF_DESKTOP=1 pnpm --filter @drymdf/frontend build
scripts.make: pnpm build && electron-forge package --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && sh make-dmg.sh
